title: AINM Protocol - Interactive Content Schemas
description: JSON Schema definitions for interactive content blocks: ButtonBlock, FormBlock, TableBlock, ApprovalBlock, and ActionBlock. See interactive.md.

ButtonBlock.description: Clickable action trigger. Renders a button that sends an ActionBlock when clicked. See interactive.md Section 4.

label.description: Text displayed on the button. Primary affordance telling the user what action the button performs.

action_id.description: Unique identifier for this interactive element within the message. Referenced by the ActionBlock on click. MUST be unique within the message's content[] array.

style.description: Semantic style token communicating the intent of the action. Clients map to their own design system. See interactive.md Section 3.2.

disabled.description: If true, button is rendered in a disabled state and is not clickable. No ActionBlock is sent for disabled buttons.

confirmation.description: If non-null, a confirmation prompt displayed before sending the ActionBlock. Provides a safety gate for destructive or irreversible actions.

FormField.description: A single input element within a FormBlock's fields array. See interactive.md Section 5.3.

name.description: Field identifier. Used as the key in the ActionBlock's data object on form submission. MUST be unique within the FormBlock's fields array.

label.description: Display label rendered next to the field input.

field_type.description: Determines the input type and rendering. See interactive.md Section 5.4 for type-specific behavior.

required.description: If true, field must have a non-empty value before form submission.

default.description: Default value for the field. Type must match the field_type.

placeholder.description: Hint text displayed inside empty text, textarea, and number fields.

validation.description: Regular expression pattern for client-side validation (ECMAScript syntax). Tested against the complete field value.

options.description: Available choices for select and multiselect field types. REQUIRED for select and multiselect. Each string is both the display label and submitted value.

FormBlock.description: Structured data input form with typed fields. Collects multiple data points from the user. See interactive.md Section 5.

action_id.description: Unique identifier for this form within the message. Referenced by the ActionBlock on submission.

title.description: Form heading displayed above the fields. Helps the user understand the form's purpose.

fields.description: Array of form field objects. Rendered in array order (top to bottom). MUST contain at least one field.

submit_label.description: Text displayed on the form's submit button. Allows context-specific button text.

TableColumn.description: Column definition for a TableBlock. See interactive.md Section 6.3.

key.description: Key used to extract this column's value from each row object.

label.description: Column header text displayed to the user.

sortable.description: If true, client allows sorting by this column. Sorting is client-side only.

align.description: Text alignment for this column's header and data cells.

RowAction.description: Action button rendered alongside each table row. See interactive.md Section 6.5.

action_id.description: Identifier referenced by the ActionBlock when the user clicks this row action.

label.description: Button text for the row action.

TableBlock.description: Tabular data display with optional per-row action buttons and client-side sorting. See interactive.md Section 6.

columns.description: Column definitions. Rendered in array order (left to right). MUST contain at least one column.

rows.description: Array of row objects. Keys correspond to column key values. MAY be empty.

title.description: Table heading displayed above the table.

row_actions.description: Action buttons rendered for each row. When clicked, ActionBlock includes full row data.

ApprovalOption.description: An option in an ApprovalBlock representing a possible approval decision.

value.description: The option value submitted in the ActionBlock's data field. Should match a valid terminal state.

style.description: Semantic style for this option's button.

ApprovalBlock.description: Approval workflow with server-enforced state machine. Used when an agent requests explicit human authorization. See interactive.md Section 7.

action_id.description: Unique identifier for this approval within the message.

title.description: Concise description of what is being approved.

description.description: Additional details about the approval. Provides context for the approver.

status.description: Current approval state. Initial value MUST be 'pending'. Terminal states (approved, rejected, changes_requested) are immutable once set. Server-enforced state machine.

options.description: Available approval decisions. MUST contain at least one option.

resolved_by.description: The AINM address of the participant who resolved this approval. Set by server when status transitions to a terminal state.

resolved_at.description: Timestamp when the approval was resolved. Set by server.

resolution_comment.description: Optional comment provided by the resolver when making the approval decision.

ActionBlock.description: User response to any interactive block. ActionBlocks are full signed messages visible to all thread participants. NOT a content block (does not extend ContentBlockBase). See interactive.md Section 8.

ref_message_id.description: The ID of the message containing the interactive block being responded to.

ref_block_index.description: Zero-based index into the referenced message's content[] array, identifying the specific interactive block.

action_id.description: The action_id of the interactive block being responded to. Must match the action_id on the target block.

data.description: The user's interaction data. Structure depends on the source block type: button click data, form field values, table row action data, or approval option selection.
